messages:
Alex: Heads-up — putting together the final changelog entry for the docs site to ship with next week's release. Need quick alignment on a couple of things: the streaming + function-calling known issue, two SDK snippet fixes, and a short migration note for Dedicated users. Can folks skim and call out anything blocking?

Maria: thanks — can you paste the current draft here? I'll sweep for tone + legal phrasing.

Alex: sure, pasted below. TL;DR: announce feature flags for structured outputs, note known issue where streaming + function calls can drop final tokens for long responses, and include SDK examples for python/js with the new streaming -> chunk-assembly pattern. Also mention embedding model rename.

Sam: I can take the SDK snippets. Which example needs changing?

Alex: the python streaming snippet in /docs/guides/streaming.md — currently shows naive for-loop on response chunks. We need to show the recommended assemble pattern and error fallback to non-streaming for function-calls.

Sam: got it. proposing this minimal pattern (will include in PR):

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.chat.stream(model="gptx-3-stream")
buffer = []
for chunk in resp:
    buffer.append(chunk.text)
# final assemble
full = "".join(buffer)
# fallback on truncated detection
if full and not full.endswith('\n'):
    full = client.chat.complete(model="gptx-3", prompt=full)
```

Sam: will push an update to the example file and link the commit here.

Maria: couple of editorial notes — avoid model names in prose except when showing exact config (we should use <model-name> placeholder). Also add a short "what to expect" line under Known issues with recommended mitigation.

Emily: Migration note for Dedicated: we need to call out that pinning a model version will preserve non-streaming behavior but autoscaling can route to quantized variants — add a short snippet on how to set "preserve_runtime=true" in dedicated config to avoid unexpected output differences.

Alex: good call. Emily, can you draft the one-paragraph migration blurb? Keep it <120 chars for the changelog summary.

Emily: posted as comment on the draft PR — short blurb: "Dedicated customers: to preserve exact runtime outputs when migrating models, set preserve_runtime=true in your capacity profile. See docs/dedicated/compat.md for details."

docs-bot: Preview build succeeded: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1775 — staging link for the updated changelog and snippets :rocket:

Alex: nice. Two quick asks before we merge: 1) Sam, include the fallback example inline where we mention streaming+functions; 2) Maria, add the mitigation bullets under Known issues and short crosslink to the migration note.

Sam: will do, aiming to push within 30m. Commit will be 9f3a2c4.

Maria: I'll do a light copy edit once Sam's commit is in. Quick note — embedding model rename: we should add a redirect entry for /models/embed-base -> /models/embed-v2, and a tiny note under "Breaking changes" about the name change and that vectors are compatible.

Alex: perfect. If both items land, I'll merge the PR and ship the release notes. Anyone object to publishing known issue as-is (with mitigation) so product can announce?

Emily: no objections. :thumbsup:

Sam: pushed 9f3a2c4 and updated streaming.md with the assemble/fallback example.

Maria: copy edits done, added mitigation bullets and redirect instruction. Also fixed one broken anchor link in the migration guide.

Alex: merging now. Thanks all.

docs-bot: PR #4127 merged by Alex — changelog published to staging.
